currentColor.why: A CSS keyword, not a color.

fgPrimary.why: Dark Button/button-primary is a fill and too dim to read as text, so dark takes the navy tag's text color.

bgPrimaryWash.why: Light is the palette's Navy 5, which no Theme token names; dark takes the navy tag's background, the pair of dark fgPrimary.

bgSecondaryWash.why: No Core Theme token names this; the value is the CDS default.

bgLineHeavy.why: No Core Theme token names this; the value is the CDS default.

bgLinePrimarySubtle.why: No Core Theme token names this; the value is the CDS default.

accentSubtleRed.why: The palette's Red 5; Core's Accents tokens start at 25.

accentBoldRed.why: The palette's Red 100, not yet tied to a Theme token.

accentSubtleGreen.why: The palette's Green 10; Core's Accents tokens start at 25.

accentBoldGreen.why: The palette's Green 100, not yet tied to a Theme token.
